name: grok
doc: xAI Grok CLI on a subscription. Renewal time is shown by /usage in an interactive session.

run.argv_doc: --no-wait-for-background: an implementer that leaves a dev server or test runner in the background must not turn a finished run into exit 1 ('stopped 1 background task').

usage.note: interactive /usage only (the CLI `grok usage` needs a session id); set the cooldown from the reset shown there or in the quota error

coordinator_env_doc: variables this CLI sets in the processes it starts: when one is set, the coordinator session runs on this CLI, on the account its account_env names in this process (unset = default home). AUTOPILOT_COORDINATOR=<cli>[/<account>] overrides.
